WPSS No. 147 of 2025
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned 
counsel for the petitioners.
2. Mr. P.S. Bisht, learned Addl. C.S.C. 
for the State.
3. Mr. Shivanand Bhatt, learned 
counsel for respondent no. 4.
4. Mr. Rajendra Arya, learned counsel 
holding the brief of Mr. Neeraj Garg, 
learned counsel for respondent no. 6.
5. Mr. P.S. Bisht learned Addl. C.S.C. 
for the State has requested for some 
time to get complete and definite 
instructions from the Director Panchyati 
Raj failing which the Director Panchyati 
Raj shall join the proceedings through

COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
WPSS No. 147 of 2025
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. K.K. Harbola, learned counsel 
holding the brief of Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, 
learned counsel for the petitioners.
2. Mr. R.S. Bisht, learned Addl. C.S.C. 
for the State.
3. Mr. Ajay Joshi, learned counsel 
holding the brief of Mr. Rahul Verma, 
learned counsel for respondent no. 3.
4. It has been informed to this Court 
that by office order dated 14.02.2025, all 
the petitioners except petitioner no. 4 are 
permitted to continue.
5. Mr. R.S. Bisht, learned Addl. C.S.C. 
for the State submits that for continuation 
of petitioner no. 4, respondent will take 
appropriate decision.
6. Issue notice to respondent nos. 4, 5 
and 6.
7. Learned counsel for the petitioners 
shall take fresh steps to serve the 
respondents within a week.
8. Since, all the petitioners are praying 
for regularization, let respondent may file 
counter affidavit within four weeks. Two 
weeks thereafter is granted to the 
petitioners to file rejoinder affidavit.
9. List this case after six weeks.
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 18.02.2025
Parul
